title: DeTox-Fed: Detecting Toxic Conversations in the Fediverse with Federated Graph Neural Networks
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of a federated graph learning framework for toxicity detection in decentralized social networks. While it contains a brief 'Ethics' section discussing data privacy and acknowledges the subjectivity of toxicity definitions across different cultural norms, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical systems as a core component.
